name: anim_hira_walk
subject: a very tall, extremely muscular horse man made of glossy brown paint with messy cream swirls, a spiky dripping brown and cream mane, wide-open eyes and a toothy grin, straight human legs with bare human feet
desc: Walk cycle in place: a confident, swaggering heavy walk toward the left, the straight human legs alternate with bare feet stepping one after the other, the huge arms swing a little in rhythm, the massive chest and shoulders bob slightly up and down with each step, the mane strands bounce, paint drips stretch and fall. Walking in place: the body does not move across the frame. The face keeps the same wide-eyed toothy grin. Thick, sticky, viscous paint.
